fields.label: Section
fields.description: Technical Offer section this component prints under

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Printed before the title, e.g. 2 X

fields.label: Sub-heading Only
fields.description: Print the title as a sub-heading, e.g. Conductivity-monitoring

fields.label: Text Before Table
fields.description: Use [[ ]] for values to fill in per project, e.g. [[160]] m³/h.

fields.label: Specification Table
fields.description: One row per line: Parameter | Value | Unit. A line without | prints as a bold group row; an empty line starts a new table. Put values the engineer must confirm in [[ ]], e.g. [[105]].
